newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bikinis denied Indonesian New Year revellers.
newsitem.headline: Bikinis denied Indonesian New Year revellers.

text.p: Officials in the Indonesian capital of Jakarta have deemed the bikini inappropriate attire for foreign performers hired to entertain New Years revellers, the Pos Kota daily reported on Tuesday.

The newspaper, whose daily diet of crime and sex reporting makes its one of the capital's most popular, quoted officials as saying the bikini was not compatiable with the local culture in the world's most populous Moslem nation.
"We will bring down any foreign artist who wears a bikini on stage," Sofiah S., head supervisor of foreign artists in the socio-political directorate at City Hall, was quoted as saying.

Sofiah said city officials, who are empowered to control entertaiment under a 1992 governor's regulation, would also crack down on erotic dancing over the holiday period, which runs into the Moslem holy month of Ramadan early next year.
"If this regulation is violated by places of entertainment there will be heavy punishment," Sofiah said.
Jakarta nightspot managers regularly bring in foreign musicians and dancers as patrons regard them more exotic than local entertainers.
